name: agent-monitor
description: AGENTS sidebar tab: every tmux pane running an AI coding agent, with a working/waiting state and a badge counting agents waiting on you. Zero-config detection from pane titles and Claude Code transcripts; an optional Claude Code hooks snippet upgrades permission-prompt detection.

agentMonitor.programs.description: Comma-separated foreground commands (tmux's pane_current_command) to treat as agents, e.g. "claude,codex".

agentMonitor.waitingThresholdSeconds.description: How long an agent's transcript can go unwritten before it's shown as waiting instead of working (only used when the pane title doesn't already say).
